title: He Is Only There When I Look Away

scenes.text: HE'S ONLY THERE WHEN I LOOK AWAY
scenes.subtext: The recording has him. The live feed doesn't.
scenes.narration: There is a man on camera six who is only there when nobody is watching the monitor.
scenes.imagePrompt: A dim office corridor at night with a man in a dark coat standing halfway down it, small in the frame, face lost in shadow, no face visible, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: The recording has him. The live feed never does. Every time I stand up to make tea, he is in the corridor. Every time I sit down, he isn't.
scenes.imagePrompt: A kettle and a mug on a filing cabinet in a cramped security office at night, the glow of monitors reflected in the kettle, no people, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.subtext: Ten minutes. Nobody in the chair.
scenes.narration: Tonight I left my phone filming the monitor, and I walked away for ten minutes.
scenes.imagePrompt: A mobile phone propped against a coffee mug on a security desk, its camera pointed at a glowing CCTV monitor showing a corridor, no people, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: On the phone he is in the corridor, facing the camera. For the whole ten minutes, he is watching my empty chair.
scenes.imagePrompt: A man in a dark coat standing in a corridor facing directly up at the camera, too far and too dark for any face to read, only a pale oval where it should be, no face visible, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain
